description: This file defines a custom PyTorch IterableDataset class for loading data from Spark Arrow files, including data conversion logic for different data types and handling of serialization and worker processes.

classes.name: _SparkPartitionTorchDataset
classes.description: A PyTorch IterableDataset for loading and converting data from Spark Arrow files, supporting specific data types and serialization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dataset with file path, schema, and number of samples to load.

methods.name: _get_field_converter
methods.description: Returns a converter function based on the field type, supporting vectors and numeric types.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the dataset, loading data from the Arrow file, converting it, and yielding samples.
